title: Everest
content: Everest, directed by Baltasar Kormákur, is an intense survival drama based on the true events of the 1996 Mount Everest disaster. The film follows climbers from two expeditions as they struggle to survive in one of the harshest environments on Earth. Faced with deadly storms, freezing temperatures, and physical exhaustion, the climbers must make impossible decisions to stay alive. The film is a stunning portrayal of human endurance, resilience, and the devastating consequences of ambition. With breathtaking cinematography and a strong ensemble cast, Everest highlights the perilous nature of high-altitude mountaineering and the power of nature in the face of human ambition.
